profileEvidence.summary: Keen workers with tuneful voices, West Country Harriers belong to the old Devonshire pied hound tradition. Their pack work developed around following hares by scent. The historic Quarme strain was kept apart from foxhound blood and was praised for flowing over Devon's steep banks.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: West Country Harriers bring a musical voice to scent work, with Devonshire roots running through historic hare packs.
